loadFailedTitle: The content workbench could not be loaded
loadFailedBody: The data may not be ready yet. Try again in a moment.
dragHint: Drag a post to another day to reschedule it.
emptyMonthBody: Press Plan the month and NIVO suggests ideas by your themes and posting rhythm, or add a post yourself.
setupFirstTitle: Set the themes and rhythm first
setupFirstBody: Planning needs your content themes and how often you post. Add them in Settings.
listEmptyBody: Plan the month or add a post to start.
planBody: NIVO asks OpenClaw for one idea per posting slot, balanced across your themes, with holidays and your real offers. It usually takes one to two minutes. You then accept or edit each idea.
planRunning: OpenClaw is planning. Keep this window open, it can take a couple of minutes.
planDonePast: {n} slots already in the past were skipped.
quickBody: Paste a topic or a few lines. NIVO writes a draft for each channel you pick.
quickTopicHint: For example: new autumn menu starts Monday, or: how to choose a sunscreen
addDateHint: Day/month/year, for example 25/12/2026. Leave empty for no date.
mediaUploadBad: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP image or an MP4 video under 10 MB.
mediaLibraryEmpty: The library has no media yet. Upload a picture.
submitted: Sent. It now waits in Approvals.
submitNeedText: Write the text for every channel first.
reopenNote: Back to draft means it needs approval again.
frozenNote: The text is locked while the post waits for approval or after approval. Use Back to draft to change it.
postedBody: Real posting to the networks is coming soon. For now, copy the text, download the pictures, post it yourself, then mark it as posted.
zaloNote: Zalo OA: posting through the official account is not connected yet, so it is copy and paste too.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
postedLinkHint: Pasting the link keeps proof that it went live.
queueEmptyBody: Posts you send for approval show up here. Nothing goes online before you approve it.
queueWhy: Posting is always your decision. NIVO never posts by itself.
queueNoDecision: This post has no open decision. Send it for approval again.
queueApproved: Approved. You can post it from the calendar or the list.
balanceBody: Planned posts per theme against the share you asked for. Skipped posts do not count.
balanceEmpty: No planned posts this month yet.
cadenceBody: Posts planned against what your posting rhythm asks for.
settingsPillarsBody: The groups of content you want to keep in balance. The weight is the share of posts each theme should get.
settingsCadenceBody: Per channel: posts a week, which days and what time (Vietnam time).
settingsBrandBody: NIVO already reads the tone you confirmed in the agent setup. Add anything specific to posts here.
settingsAutoBody: They only write messages in Office and drafts. They never post and never skip your approval.
autoReminderBody: Every morning from 7:00, a message in Office lists what is due today and what is not approved yet.
autoOffer: Draft a post when a new offer is added
autoOfferBody: When a price list or promotion appears in your knowledge, NIVO writes a draft about it for you to approve.
autoSummaryBody: Every Monday from 8:00, a short summary of last week in Office.
readOnly: Only an owner or manager can change this.
claimPromise: The phrase "{phrase}" sounds like a promised result. Remove or rewrite it.
claimFigure: The figure "{figure}" is not in the business information. Check it before posting.
claimLength: The post is {length} characters; shorten it (suggested maximum {max}).
err_role: Only the owner or a manager can do this.
err_wrong_status: This post is not in a state that allows this (it may already be sent for approval or posted).
err_title_required: Enter the title or idea of the post.
err_time_invalid: The posting time must look like 19:30.
err_pillar_duplicate: Two themes cannot have the same name.
err_channel_invalid: That channel is not valid for this post.
err_url_invalid: The link of the post must start with http:// or https://.
err_plan_no_pillars: There are no content themes yet. Add at least one theme before planning.
err_plan_no_cadence: There is no posting rhythm yet. Choose channels and posts per week first.
err_plan_no_slots: No days are left this month for the chosen posting rhythm.
err_ai_busy: NIVO is busy, try again in a few minutes.
err_ai_unreadable: OpenClaw returned an answer that could not be read. Try again.
err_ai_empty: OpenClaw produced nothing usable. Try again.
err_drafting_off: The owner has switched off drafting (Authority: Draft a post = never).
err_topic_short: Enter a topic of at least a few words.
err_text_missing: A channel has no text yet. Write it or remove that channel.
err_frozen: The post is sent for approval or posted, so its text cannot be edited. Reopen it as a draft to edit.
err_delete_status: Only ideas, drafts and skipped posts can be deleted.
err_transition_status: This post cannot change to that status from where it is.
err_published_locked: The post is already posted, its date cannot change.
err_upload_bad: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP picture, or an MP4 video under 10 MB.
err_gate_failed: It could not be sent for approval. Try again in a few minutes.
err_not_drafted: Write the post before sending it for approval.
err_input: The data sent was not valid.
err_refused: You are not allowed to do this.
err_unknown: That did not work. Try again in a few minutes.
evReopen: {who} moved the post back to draft (it needs approval again).
evRejected: {who} did not approve the post and moved it back to draft to edit.
decisionDraftNote: {title} · Drafting is internal work and nothing is sent out; the draft_post permission is set by the owner on the Authority page.
promptBrandVoiceDefault: Brand voice: friendly, genuine, useful, polite address.
promptBrandFacts: REAL INFORMATION ABOUT THE BUSINESS (use only what is here):
promptBrandNoKnowledge: (no knowledge yet: write general content only, with no prices, offers, addresses or phone numbers)
promptGuardExtra: Write in simple Vietnamese, short, not flowery, without hard technical words.
promptNoOffers: (no offers found in the information: do NOT create ideas about discounts)
promptPlanRole: You schedule social media content for a small business in Vietnam. You only propose post ideas; the business owner approves them.
promptPlanJson: Return ONLY one JSON object of the form: {"ideas":[{"slot":<posting slot number>,"title":"<short title under 80 characters>","brief":"<2-3 sentences: content angle, key point, real information to use, call to action>"}]}. Exactly one idea per posting slot, matching the theme assigned to that slot. Add no text outside the JSON. Write the titles and briefs in Vietnamese.
promptPlanSlots:
POSTING SLOTS (Vietnam time). Each slot has an assigned theme; write the idea for that theme:
{lines}
promptPlanOffers:
REAL OFFERS AND PRODUCTS you may mention:
{lines}
promptPlanExisting:
ALREADY IN THIS MONTH (do not repeat):
{lines}
promptPlanRules: A slot with an OCCASION must build its idea around it (but never invent a promotion for it). The ideas must differ from each other. Do not invent offers or figures.
promptDraftRole: You write social media posts for a small business in Vietnam. You write a draft; the business owner reads, edits and approves it before posting.
promptDraftJson: Return ONLY one JSON object: {"title":"<short title>","pillar":"<exactly one theme name or null>","hashtags":["#general"],"media":[<numbers of suggested images or leave empty>],"variants":{__SHAPE__}}. "text" is the ready-to-post content, keeping line breaks as \n. "note" is a short note for the owner (for example a filming suggestion) and may be empty. Add no text outside the JSON. Write the post texts in Vietnamese.
promptDraftLibrary:
IMAGES IN THE LIBRARY (pick at most 2 that fit, write their numbers in "media"):
{lines}
promptDraftNoLibrary: The library has no images: set "media" to [].
err_ai_quota: The AI allowance for this period is used up. See the Usage page.
